title: Certify QF_UF refutations in Lean through the clause log
summary: Extends the native-certificate pipeline so QF_UF refutations over one uninterpreted sort are exported from Z3's clause log and kernel-checked in Lean, encoding the sort as a universally quantified type with indexed symbol families and proving euf lemmas with grind. All 28 gating CI checks passed on the first run and the review's two minor and two nit findings were fixed before merge.
